pages.title: Bootstrap Artifact
pages.text: An object with no origin. It was handed back from the future, kept, and later sent back to become the thing that was handed over, so nobody ever made it. Its information came from nowhere and it shows no wear at all, even though it is, in a sense, infinitely old.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed Paradox Residue through a Closed Timelike Curve with Chronon Gas in the Causality Loop Engine and waited. Something arrived that I had not yet made. I have since made it, and sent it back, and I am not sure who started this.

Made in $(item)Causality Loop Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Causality Violation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Eternity Catalyst, Reality Anchor, Temporal Singularity, Unified Notes III.
